approval_decisions_amounts_reconcile.name: approval_decisions_amounts_reconcile
approval_decisions_amounts_reconcile.value:
("approval_decisions"."approved_subtotal_cents" is null and "approval_decisions"."approved_tax_cents" is null and "approval_decisions"."approved_total_cents" is null)
        or ("approval_decisions"."approved_subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "approval_decisions"."approved_tax_cents" >= 0
            and "approval_decisions"."approved_total_cents" = "approval_decisions"."approved_subtotal_cents" + "approval_decisions"."approved_tax_cents")

approved_line_items_total_reconciles.name: approved_line_items_total_reconciles
approved_line_items_total_reconciles.value:
("approved_line_items"."approved_quantity" is null and "approved_line_items"."approved_unit_price_cents" is null)
        or ("approved_line_items"."approved_quantity" >= 0 and "approved_line_items"."approved_unit_price_cents" >= 0
            and "approved_line_items"."approved_line_total_cents" = "approved_line_items"."approved_quantity"::bigint * "approved_line_items"."approved_unit_price_cents")

budget_requests_requested_reconciles.name: budget_requests_requested_reconciles
budget_requests_requested_reconciles.value:
("budget_requests"."requested_subtotal_cents" is null and "budget_requests"."requested_tax_cents" is null and "budget_requests"."requested_total_cents" is null)
        or ("budget_requests"."requested_subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "budget_requests"."requested_tax_cents" >= 0
            and "budget_requests"."requested_total_cents" = "budget_requests"."requested_subtotal_cents" + "budget_requests"."requested_tax_cents")

budget_requests_approved_reconciles.name: budget_requests_approved_reconciles
budget_requests_approved_reconciles.value:
("budget_requests"."approved_subtotal_cents" is null and "budget_requests"."approved_tax_cents" is null and "budget_requests"."approved_total_cents" is null)
        or ("budget_requests"."approved_subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "budget_requests"."approved_tax_cents" >= 0
            and "budget_requests"."approved_total_cents" = "budget_requests"."approved_subtotal_cents" + "budget_requests"."approved_tax_cents")

budget_requests_submitted_has_snapshot.name: budget_requests_submitted_has_snapshot
budget_requests_submitted_has_snapshot.value:
"budget_requests"."status" = 'draft' or ("budget_requests"."tax_rate" is not null and "budget_requests"."requested_total_cents" is not null
        and "budget_requests"."reference_number" is not null and "budget_requests"."submitted_at" is not null)

budget_requests_approved_has_amounts.name: budget_requests_approved_has_amounts
budget_requests_approved_has_amounts.value: "budget_requests"."status" not in ('approved', 'closed') or "budget_requests"."approved_total_cents" is not null

expense_decisions_amounts_reconcile.name: expense_decisions_amounts_reconcile
expense_decisions_amounts_reconcile.value:
("expense_decisions"."approved_subtotal_cents" is null and "expense_decisions"."approved_tax_cents" is null and "expense_decisions"."approved_total_cents" is null)
        or ("expense_decisions"."approved_subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "expense_decisions"."approved_tax_cents" >= 0
            and "expense_decisions"."approved_total_cents" = "expense_decisions"."approved_subtotal_cents" + "expense_decisions"."approved_tax_cents")

expense_decisions_approval_has_amount.name: expense_decisions_approval_has_amount
expense_decisions_approval_has_amount.value: "expense_decisions"."decision" not in ('approved', 'approved_different_amount') or "expense_decisions"."approved_total_cents" is not null

expense_payments_cheque_signers.name: expense_payments_cheque_signers
expense_payments_cheque_signers.value:
"expense_payments"."method" <> 'cheque' or ("expense_payments"."cheque_signer_1_id" is not null and "expense_payments"."cheque_signer_2_id" is not null
        and "expense_payments"."cheque_signer_1_id" <> "expense_payments"."cheque_signer_2_id" and "expense_payments"."reference" is not null)

expense_submissions_amounts_reconcile.name: expense_submissions_amounts_reconcile
expense_submissions_amounts_reconcile.value:
("expense_submissions"."subtotal_cents" is null and "expense_submissions"."tax_cents" is null and "expense_submissions"."total_cents" is null)
        or ("expense_submissions"."subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "expense_submissions"."tax_cents" >= 0
            and "expense_submissions"."total_cents" = "expense_submissions"."subtotal_cents" + "expense_submissions"."tax_cents")

expense_submissions_approved_reconcile.name: expense_submissions_approved_reconcile
expense_submissions_approved_reconcile.value:
("expense_submissions"."approved_subtotal_cents" is null and "expense_submissions"."approved_tax_cents" is null and "expense_submissions"."approved_total_cents" is null)
        or ("expense_submissions"."approved_subtotal_cents" >= 0 and "expense_submissions"."approved_tax_cents" >= 0
            and "expense_submissions"."approved_total_cents" = "expense_submissions"."approved_subtotal_cents" + "expense_submissions"."approved_tax_cents")

expense_submissions_submitted_has_snapsh.name: expense_submissions_submitted_has_snapshot
expense_submissions_submitted_has_snapsh.value:
"expense_submissions"."status" = 'draft' or ("expense_submissions"."total_cents" is not null
        and "expense_submissions"."reference_number" is not null and "expense_submissions"."submitted_at" is not null)

expense_submissions_charged_has_amount.name: expense_submissions_charged_has_amount
expense_submissions_charged_has_amount.value:
"expense_submissions"."status" not in ('approved', 'processing', 'paid', 'purchased', 'closed', 'cancelled')
        or "expense_submissions"."approved_total_cents" is not null

user_departments_backup_rank_valid.name: user_departments_backup_rank_valid
user_departments_backup_rank_valid.value:
("user_departments"."representative_type" = 'backup') = ("user_departments"."backup_rank" is not null)
        and ("user_departments"."backup_rank" is null or "user_departments"."backup_rank" in (1, 2))

user_departments_away_primary_only.name: user_departments_away_primary_only
user_departments_away_primary_only.value: ("user_departments"."away_from" is null and "user_departments"."away_until" is null) or "user_departments"."representative_type" = 'primary'

user_preferences_away_dates.name: user_preferences_away_dates
user_preferences_away_dates.value:
("user_preferences"."away_from" is not null or "user_preferences"."away_until" is null)
        and ("user_preferences"."away_until" is null or "user_preferences"."away_until" > "user_preferences"."away_from")
